subject: Quantized GPU pool requirements & rollout checkpoints
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: María López <maria.lopez@aegisbio.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Quantized GPU pool requirements & rollout checkpoints

Hi María — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the immediate asks so we have a single source of truth: 

Pain points we heard from Aegis:
- Model LLM+fine-tuned ensembles need stable tail latency at 150ms p50 for 512-token contexts; p95 target 450ms.
- Regulatory requirement: PHI-adjacent workloads must run in an isolated tenant/enclave with customer-managed keying.
- Burst patterns: baseline load ~800 concurrent infer requests/day, but spikes to 7k qps during batch scoring windows.

Goals you outlined:
1) Reserve a quantized GPU pool (NVIDIA H100 / 8-bit quantization) sized for sustained throughput that meets p95 SLA for production.
2) Ensure network isolation (VPC peering + private link) and KMS integration for keys.
3) Launch a 6-week pilot: canary traffic -> full production handoff.

Recommended next steps (from our side):
- Karthik: send a sizing + SLA proposal (attached) and an ops runbook draft for the pilot.
- Evelyn: will scope the isolation checklist and KMS/HSM integration requirements.
- María / Aegis: confirm procurement contact and any timing constraints for December.

What I need from you by EOD Mon (Nov 8):
- Confirm whether Aegis requires FIPS 140-2 HSM or customer KMS is acceptable.
- Share a short list of 2–3 peak batch windows so we can simulate traffic.

Attachments: redwood-quant-pool-sla-proposal.pdf (proposal + sample SLA), mop-draft-aegis.xlsx (pilot MOP with milestones).

If that aligns, I’ll loop Ben to put an indicative commercial estimate and commit cadence.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
From: María López <maria.lopez@aegisbio.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@aegisbio.com>, Aegis Procurement <procurement@aegisbio.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quantized GPU pool requirements & rollout checkpoints

Karthik — thanks for the concise recap. This matches what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) KMS: we must use our corporate KMS (Azure Key Vault) with customer-managed keys. FIPS HSM is nice-to-have but not mandatory for pilot.
2) Isolation: network isolation plus disk encryption is required; we will need an SOC2/AICPA statement on your end for the environment in which the enclave runs.
3) Batch windows: primary scoring batch is nightly at 02:00–03:30 PT; a secondary afternoon window 14:00–15:00 PT. Peak qps during those windows last ~10–12 minutes.

Procurement: looping in procurement for timing. Diego — can you confirm our internal sign-off cadence for December commitments?

We’ll review the attachments and get back with any redlines. For the pilot, we prefer a 6-week window with canary + 2-week stabilization.

Best,
María
Senior ML Ops Lead
Aegis Biotech

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: María López <maria.lopez@aegisbio.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@aegisbio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 10:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quantized GPU pool requirements & rollout checkpoints

María / Diego — looping in a brief commercial outline so procurement has something to work from. 

High-level pilot commercial (indicative)
- Pilot (6 weeks): reserved quantized pool (8x H100-equivalent vGPUs, 8-bit quantization profile) with isolation: $28k (one-time pilot fee + 6 weeks of reserved capacity).
- Production estimate (12-month committed): monthly reserved pool for baseline throughput sized to meet p95 SLA: $95k/mo.
- Cancellation: 60-day notice on reserved commitments; pilot refundable up to 50% if termination prior to week 2.
- SLA: p50 120ms, p95 450ms for 512-token contexts; credits up to 10% of monthly invoice for sustained SLA misses (per SLA schedule in attached PDF).

Operational notes:
- We can integrate with Azure Key Vault for CMK; Evelyn will run the security checklist and provide an onboarding timeline (2–3 weeks to complete environment validation).
- We recommend starting the pilot on the lower quantization aggressiveness profile and move to 8-bit during week 3 after quality validation.

Next steps: 
1) Aegis to confirm KMS choice and December decision cadence (Diego).
2) Karthik & Evelyn to schedule a 45‑minute kickoff (ops + security + engineering) next week.
3) Ben to submit an official MSA/quote after Aegis confirms pilot acceptance.

Happy to hop on a call to walk procurement through the pilot commercial.

--
